title: How To Activate Ai Studio In Clo 2025.1
description:
In CLO 2025.1, you can experience all AI-powered features in one place with CLO AI Studio, and access new AI tools faster than ever. Find the AI studio next to the New Library. Happy creating! 

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord?utm_campaign=multi_item_banner_JointheOfficialCLODiscord&utm_medium=referral&utm_source=later-linkinbio

transcript: Hi everyone. My name is Ariel. And today I'm going to be talking about how to activate or turn on the new AI studio in Clo 2025.1. If you have updated to 2025.1, you may have noticed that a lot of the AI features, the buttons have been grayed out or all of the AI features have been moved into the AI studio in the upper right-hand corner, this pink button here next to the new location of the Clo library. In order to activate this button, which will activate all the studio features, you first need to log into your Clo account at clo3d.com. So let's go ahead and jump over there. Shall we? All right, everyone. Now that we're at clo3d.com, you can log in just like you would normally do through the Clo set link. Once you're logged in, you can head to the upper right-hand corner, which is going to take you to your account page. Once you're at your account page at the left-hand side, as you can see, once you come down with your cursor, you're going to notice there is a new option here called the AI studio plugin. Click on this plugin, which is going to take you to the plugin page. To activate all of these features, you can click the edit button in the right-hand corner, and this will allow you to toggle on or off these different features. Once you've toggled on as many or as few as you would like, the AI texture generator, AI graphic generator, AI render enhancer, AI pose generator, and pattern drafter, you can click the save button. And after you click the save button, all you need to do is relaunch Clo. If we head back over into Clo, this button will now be activated as well as all the other AI buttons across the Clo platform, as long as you have turned those features on at clo3d.com. And you're going to see there is a homepage. This is where we have our text, texture generator, graphic generator, as well as the AI render enhancer. I hope you guys find this video helpful and useful. Stay tuned for further deep dives into all the newest 2025.1 features with Phoebe. Happy Clo-ing and see you soon.
markdown_content: ## Overview of AI Studio Activation in CLO 2025.1 This section explains how to activate the AI Studio in CLO 2025.1, covering the relocation of AI features, login procedures, and enabling specific AI plugins on the CLO website to unlock AI functionalities within the software. --- ## Locating AI Studio in CLO 2025.1 In CLO 2025.1, all AI features have been consolidated into the AI Studio, accessible via a pink button located in the upper right-hand corner of the interface, next to the CLO library. Upon updating to this version, users may notice that individual AI feature buttons are grayed out or disabled until the AI Studio is activated. --- ## Logging into clo3d.com to Enable AI Studio To activate the AI Studio, you must first log into your CLO account at [clo3d.com](https://clo3d.com). The login process remains the same as previous versions, accessible via the CLO desktop app login or directly through the website. Once logged in, navigate to your account page by clicking the upper right-hand corner user icon or menu. This page serves as the control center for managing your account and plugins. --- ## Activating AI Studio Plugins on clo3d.com On your account page, a new menu option labeled **AI Studio Plugin** appears on the left sidebar. Clicking this opens the plugin management page where you can enable or disable various AI features. To activate the AI Studio features: 1. Click the **Edit** button at the top right of the AI Studio Plugin page. 2. Toggle on any combination of the following AI features: - AI Texture Generator - AI Graphic Generator - AI Render Enhancer - AI Pose Generator - Pattern Drafter 3. After selecting desired features, click **Save** to apply changes. --- ## Applying Changes in the CLO Desktop Application After saving your plugin preferences on the website, relaunch the CLO desktop application. The AI Studio button and all enabled AI feature buttons will now be active within the software. Within CLO, the AI Studio homepage provides access to: - Text-based Texture Generator - Graphic Generator - AI Render Enhancer These tools become available only after activation through your CLO account. --- ## Summary Activating AI Studio in CLO 2025.1 requires logging into your account at clo3d.com, enabling AI plugins via the AI Studio Plugin settings, and relaunching the CLO application. This process centralizes all AI functionalities, improving workflow with integrated AI tools such as texture and graphic generators, render enhancers, and pattern drafting assistants.
